description: Western Province Provincial Council - Notify the Statute to Execute Powers of Local Government Institutions No. 02 of 2017, of the Provincial Council of Western Province
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the enactment of a provincial statute ("Statute on Execution of Powers of the Local Government Authorities No. 02 of 2017") that provides legal provisions for land development planning, construction approvals, and related regulatory matters. It establishes a legal framework, amends existing ordinances, and grants specific powers to local government institutions, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel or structural announcement.
